snippet.title: AMY WINEHOUSE LIVE ROTTERDAM 2004 UNEDITED VERSION 4K REMASTERED
snippet.description:
4K remastered by me for the Amy Winehouse Family of fans❤️🙏🏻

In June 2004, Amy Winehouse played at the Rotterdam Import Festival, performing songs like "You Sent Me Flying" and "Know You Now" from her debut album Frank. This was her first performance in the Netherlands, just one month before her appearance at the North Sea Jazz Festival. During this period, she also gave an interview in Rotterdam about how jazz influenced her singing, mentioning artists like Sarah Vaughan and Dinah Washington.  
Rotterdam Import Festival (June 19, 2004)

Venue: Port of Rotterdam

Date: June 19, 2004

Significance: This was Amy Winehouse's first concert in the Netherlands.

Performances: She performed songs from her debut album Frank, including "You Sent Me Flying" and "Know You Now.

snippet.title: Amy Winehouse LIVE Benicássim 2007 FULL CONCERT 4K REMASTERED
snippet.description:
Amy Winehouse performed at the Festival Internacional de Benicàssim (FIB) on July 22, 2007. This performance was part of the festival's lineup that year and took place in Benicàssim, Spain.  
The performance occurred on the fourth day of the festival.
It was her first gig in Spain after the release of her second album, "Back to Black".

snippet.title: AMY WINEHOUSE LOVE IS A LOSING GAME LIVE @ JOES PUB NEW YORK 2007
snippet.description:
Amy performs at her first American headline show at Joe's Pub :

Amy Winehouse performed with The Dap-Kings at Joe's Pub in New York City on January 16, 2007, marking her American debut live performance. 
The show served as an introduction to the singer in the U.S. following the release of her critically acclaimed album Back to Black.

snippet.title: MICHAEL JACKSON ACCEPTS MULTIPLE AWARDS WORLD MUSIC AWARDS 1993
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson attended the World Music Awards in Monaco on May 12, 1993, where he received the awards for Best Selling American Artist of the Year, World's Best Selling Recording Artist of the Year, and World's Best Selling Recording Artist of the Era. 
He was presented with one of the awards by Princess Stephanie of Monaco 🇲🇨
